guard.title: Guard mode

modernization.eventsCoverage: Counts cover the returned security event history, not a theft detection assessment.
modernization.panels: Guard location, controls, settings, status, and event history
modernization.policyOnly: Saved policy only; not confirmation of active monitoring or successful arming.
modernization.armingEffect: Enabling saves policy and requests door locking, then Sentry on. Disabling saves policy only; it does not unlock doors or turn Sentry off.
modernization.panicEffects: This requests Sentry mode on, then horn honking, then light flashing. It does not lock doors, send notifications, or create a guard event. Commands can fail or complete only partially.
modernization.sourceUnknown: Source unavailable; no security conclusion can be drawn.
modernization.saveFailure: Policy may have been saved even if arming failed. Review the refreshed policy and live lock/Sentry status before trying again.
modernization.stepUp: Saving or enabling policy and activating panic may require step-up authentication.
modernization.eventTrigger: Triggered denotes the latest unacknowledged non-test event, not confirmed theft or an active monitoring engine.
modernization.sensitivityPolicy: Saved movement threshold policy; automatic detection is not established.
modernization.overviewSources: Saved policy, current verified vehicle fields, and returned security event history have independent sources.
modernization.selectVehicle: Select a vehicle in the workspace header to load guard data.
modernization.engineLimitation: Automatic guard monitoring, theft detection, and auto-panic are not established by the current service. These settings persist policy; verify vehicle security using current lock and Sentry readings.
modernization.geofencePolicy: Saved home-area policy; leaving this area is not proof of an active automatic alert service.
modernization.autoPanicPolicy: Saved auto-panic preference; no automatic execution worker is established.

guard.subtitle: Anti-theft monitoring and emergency response
guard.panicDesc: Flash lights, honk horn, lock doors, enable sentry, and notify all channels
guard.homeGeofenceHelp: Vehicle will trigger alert if it leaves this area
guard.autoPanicHelp: Automatically execute panic actions when guard is triggered
